map.📐 冷负荷构成: 📐 What Makes Up the Cooling Load
map.总冷负荷 = 车体传热（与容积、温差、隔热相关）＋ 乘员散热（每人约 0.1~0: Total cooling load = body heat transfer (related to volume, temperature difference and insulation) + occupant heat (about 0.1~0.15 kW each) + solar radiation + fresh-air load. Volume is only the base term; noon sun and a full cabin raise the demand substantially.
map.车载空调长期处于振动、高温与变转速工况，COP 低于家用机。选压缩机时建议按计算: Mobile systems run under vibration, heat and variable speed, so COP is below domestic units. Size the compressor 15%~25% above the calculated load and check condenser area at the same time; undersizing means it never stops running on hot days yet still fails to cool.

map.按容积与满负荷项估制冷量: Estimating capacity from volume and load terms
map.5 m³ 车室、2 人、环境 35 ℃、强日照与标准隔热下，冷负荷 = (5 ×: With a 5 m³ cabin, 2 occupants, 35 °C ambient, strong sun and standard insulation, the cooling load = (5 × 0.40 + 5 × 0.012 × 15 + 2 × 0.13 + 0.5) ≈ 3.66 kW, about 1.46 hp; adding a 20% margin suggests sizing for about 4.4 kW (1.76 hp). Each extra m³ adds about 0.58 kW, including the temperature-drop term. Above the 35 °C rating the corrected COP falls, so compressor power rises for the same load and the system should not be sized to the limit.

map.1 匹≈2.5kW 制冷量。车载因振动与高温工况效率低于家用，应按上限留余量，并: 1 hp ≈ 2.5 kW of cooling capacity. Car systems are less efficient than domestic ones because of vibration and high temperatures, so size to the upper bound with margin and check compressor displacement and condenser heat-rejection area.
map.为什么高温天不凉？: Why does it stop cooling on hot days?
map.散热不良（冷凝器脏堵、风扇不转）、冷媒不足或膨胀阀故障都会降效。先查冷凝温度与环: Poor heat rejection (dirty condenser, dead fan), low refrigerant or a faulty expansion valve all cut performance. Check condensing temperature and ambient first, then read high and low pressures to judge leakage or blockage.
